institution_name: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce (Autonomous), Nerul, Navi Mumbai
app_archetype: Enterprise Financial SaaS / Institutional Financial Intelligence Platform
target_quality_bar: Premium fintech + institutional treasury & accounting intelligence (Bloomberg Terminal meets Modern Institutional Treasury)

user_choices.theme_mode: Both light and dark themes with dark as default
user_choices.currency_format: INR ₹ with Indian number formatting (Lakhs and Crores e.g. ₹1,25,40,000 / 1.25 Cr)
user_choices.startup_sequence: Premium startup/loading animation with subtle finance-related motion (floating currency silhouettes, financial data particles, flowing transaction lines, subtle graph draw) followed by SIES logo reveal and 'SIES FinCore' title
user_choices.animations: Restrained, high-quality, professional micro-animations (number count-ups, sparklines drawing, skeleton loaders, subtle table row reveals)
user_choices.branding: Exact SIES College branding: SIES logo with orange sunburst mark, 'SIES' wordmark, 'RISE WITH EDUCATION' tagline, and '(Nerul) College of Arts, Science & Commerce (Autonomous)' subtext
user_choices.em_dash_rule: NEVER use the em dash character (— or —). Use standard hyphens (-), en-dashes with spaces, or pipes (|) instead.

typography.primary_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, or system-ui sans-serif
typography.financial_numbers_font: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, or tabular lining figures (font-mono / tabular-nums)
anti_patterns: No decorative script or serif display fonts for enterprise tables
No font sizes larger than 5xl (no 7xl or 8xl text)
Always set tabular-nums for all financial numbers and grid balances

rules: NO transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, popovers, sticky headers, or submenus
NO full neon gradients, NO rainbow accents, NO bright purple AI slop (#7351B7 strictly forbidden)
Status indications MUST combine color + icon + clear status text (never color alone)
Hover states must explicitly declare hover text color to prevent invisible dark-on-dark text

shell_structure.sidebar: Collapsible desktop sidebar (260px expanded, 72px collapsed) with SIES FinCore logo mark, institutional badge, and 14 primary navigation modules
shell_structure.header: Sticky top bar with z-50, backdrop blur, breadcrumbs, search (Ctrl+K), Financial Year switcher (e.g. FY 2025-26), notifications panel with unread badge, light/dark theme toggle, user profile menu
shell_structure.main_canvas: Max-width fluid layout with generous padding (p-6 to p-8), responsive grid breakpoints, zero horizontal scrollbar leaks

features: Drill-down side panel/modal on row click
tables.styling: Dense typography, thin borders (#1E293B / #E2E8F0), numeric right-alignment, hover row elevation

elements: Current Value in INR (formatted in Lakhs/Crores)
Visual Trend Sparkline or mini bar
Status indicator pill (Positive / Warning / Danger / Neutral)

modals_and_sheets.styling: Semi-solid surface bg with dark backdrop backdrop-blur-md, clear close action button, explicit text contrast

actions: Search student invoice or fee receipt

loading_screen.description: Full-screen high-tech financial sequence on initial boot
animations: Flowing matrix of monetary transaction particles
Line graph auto-drawing with glow effect
Smooth scale & reveal of official SIES emblem with sunburst ray motion
Elegant title reveal: 'SIES FinCore' - Enterprise Financial Intelligence

micro_interactions.number_countup: Animated count-up for major KPI totals on tab change or filter apply
micro_interactions.chart_draw: Smooth path draw transitions for Recharts / SVG line charts
micro_interactions.skeleton_loaders: Shimmering dark/light skeleton blocks matching table and card layout structures

data_testid_convention.rule: Every interactive button, link, tab, input, table, modal, and key metric card MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all numbers use Indian Numbering System (e.g. ₹1,45,20,500 for 1.45 Crores or ₹8,50,000 for 8.5 Lakhs). Include a helper utility formatINR(value).
Strictly avoid the em dash character in any text string or UI label. Use hyphens (-) or colons (:) instead.
Default theme must be dark ('dark' class applied to root html/body or state 'dark'). Toggling theme changes all semantic classes smoothly.
Implement the full startup/loading sequence on initial render with a option to skip or re-replay from header.
Ensure complete drill-down capability: clicking any KPI card or ledger entry opens a detail view with line-item transactions.
The AI Assistant must be realistic, interactive, and pre-populated with institutional queries like 'Show top 5 departments exceeding Q3 budget' or 'Fee collection variance in Science Stream'.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for automated test verification.
